title: LogisticsResult
description: payload.kind == 'logistics_result'. Notification payload from multi-stop logistics routing (ADR-0043). Published on #events, correlated by correlation_id.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection for the computed route, or null when unavailable.

order.description: Optimized visiting order. Single-vehicle: flat array of stop indices (e.g. [0,2,1,3]). Multi-vehicle (VRP-lite): a list of one array per vehicle (e.g. [[0,2,1],[3,4]]). null when unavailable.

total_distance_km.description: Total route distance in kilometers, or null.

total_duration_min.description: Total route duration in minutes, or null.

error.description: Error message when ok is false, else null.

routes.description: Per-vehicle routes for multi-vehicle VRP-lite results.

depot.description: Depot [lat, lon] this vehicle started from.

stops.description: Visited stops as [lat, lon] pairs in visiting order.

arrivals.description: Per-stop arrival epoch seconds, parallel to order (null at depot sentinel).

violations.description: Number of stops on this route that missed their time window.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection for this vehicle's route.

vehicles.description: Number of vehicles in the multi-vehicle solution.

window_violations.description: Total time-window violations across all vehicles.

start_time.description: Echoed depot departure time in seconds.
